metrics.accountExportNote: When you reached which steps in this app — and, if a test was running, which version you were shown.
metrics.accountDeletionNote: The link between those steps and your account. The bare counts remain, but they can no longer be traced to anybody.

metricsAdmin.title: Metrics
metricsAdmin.subtitle: Where new customers stop, who comes back, and whether a change helped.
metricsAdmin.funnelSubtitle: How many members reached each step, in the order the config names them.
metricsAdmin.funnelEmptyBody: List the milestones under “funnel” in modules/metrics/config.json, and call track() where they actually happen.
metricsAdmin.unlistedBody: These events are being recorded but are in no declared step: {events}. Usually that is a mistyped call.
metricsAdmin.cohortsSubtitle: Share of members who did something again in week N after their first event. This is activity, not payment.
metricsAdmin.cohortsEmptyBody: Once members trigger events, one row per calendar week appears here.
metricsAdmin.splitSubtitle: Measured as: “{exposure}” is who was in it, “{goal}” is who succeeded.
metricsAdmin.splitManyVariantsBody: Comparing three variants pairwise raises the error rate, and this module corrects for nothing. The counts are above; the verdict is deliberately absent.
metricsAdmin.verdictNotEnoughBody: A verdict needs at least {exposed} members in each variant and {reached} successes in each. Below that, the gap between the rates is chance rather than a result.
metricsAdmin.verdictNoDifferenceTitle: No difference you can rely on
metricsAdmin.verdictNoDifferenceBody: The variants do not differ enough to credit the change. Let it run longer, or try something bolder.
metricsAdmin.verdictDifferenceBody: The difference holds at 95% confidence. That is for this period, and assuming nothing else changed while it ran.
metricsAdmin.splitsEmptyBody: A test is an id, an event for who was in it, an event for success, and two variants — declared under “experiments” in modules/metrics/config.json.
metricsAdmin.brokenBody: While this is the case nothing is recorded. An experiment named here is not running — nobody is being assigned to it:
